subject: PO field requirements, net terms and sweep schedule
messages:
From: Aaron Lee <procurement@pioneerthera.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Sutherland <amy.sutherland@pioneerthera.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 12:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO field requirements and billing cadence for Redwood services

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo this week — Pioneer is keen to move forward with a pilot. Before legal/finance can issue a PO, procurement needs to confirm a few billing/PO items so we can map to our ERP:

- Required PO fields: legal entity name, Redwood vendor number (if any), contract/reference ID, BU/cost center code, GL account, tax ID, PO type (one-time vs recurring).
- Invoice cadence: we prefer a single consolidated monthly invoice per legal entity but can do weekly invoice "sweeps" if it makes ERP reconciliation easier.
- Net terms: our standard is net45 for enterprise vendors; we can consider net30 for early-pay discounts.
- PO format: we can send a PDF PO or an EDI 850; which do you accept?

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) accept a PO that includes the fields above, 2) issue a consolidated monthly invoice and include internal PO number mapping, and 3) whether finance would consider a small discount for net30 vs net45?

I attached our internal PO template for reference. If you can send a short mapping doc showing which fields Redwood requires on the PO, that will speed legal/ERP setup.

Thanks — looking to get the signed PO to our AP team by next week if possible.

Aaron Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
Pioneer Therapeutics
Attachment: Pioneer_PO_template.pdf (PDF, 38KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Lee <procurement@pioneerthera.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 15:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO field requirements and billing cadence for Redwood services

Hi Aaron,

Appreciate the clear checklist — and great to hear you're moving toward a pilot. Short answers up front:

1) Yes, we can accept a PO that includes the fields you listed. We require a minimum set (vendor legal name, Redwood vendor ID if available, PO number, contract/reference ID, and cost center/BU). Optional but helpful: GL code and tax ID.

2) Invoice cadence: our standard is a single consolidated monthly invoice per legal entity. We can support weekly EDI 810s or weekly PDFs if Pioneer needs a sweep model for reconciliation, but for the pilot monthly consolidation is easiest.

3) Net terms: Redwood's default is net30 for new customers. We do evaluate net45 on enterprise agreements, usually tied to a purchase commitment or an annual contract. Ben (cc'd) is our finance lead and can propose acceptable options.

I'll attach our PO field mapping so your ERP team can validate. Ben/Vivek — FYI: Pioneer is asking for net45 by default; they may ask for a small discount for net30. Can we take a quick look and propose a recommendation?

Best,

Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_PO_field_mapping.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Lee <procurement@pioneerthera.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO field requirements and billing cadence for Redwood services

Hi Aaron — thanks for the details and the template. A few points from finance to make this smooth and to outline potential tradeoffs: 

- PO fields: we confirm the required mapping in the attached spreadsheet. Important: the PO must reference the Redwood deal id (P-THERA-202704) in the "Contract/Ref ID" field so our billing system can auto-apply discounts and map charges.
- Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoice on the 5th of the following month is our default for enterprise customers; we can provide weekly CSV/EDI exports in parallel if your AP team needs interim reporting.
- Net terms / discounting: options we can offer:
  * Net45 (no discount) — acceptable for annual contracts with a signed PO referencing the deal id.
  * Net30 — we can offer a 1.5% early-payment discount if Pioneer pays in 30 days.
  * Annual prepay — if Pioneer prepays for 12 months up front, we can offer a 5% prepay discount.

If Pioneer is comfortable with net45 and monthly consolidated invoices, we can proceed without additional approvals. If you opt for net30 + 1.5% discount, I will need confirmation in the PO notes and finance will apply the credit.

Also attaching the mapping doc (spreadsheet) showing exact ERP field names we expect. Please have your ERP/AP lead validate and return a sample filled PO so we can run a one-off ingestion test.

Thanks — I'll hold on the discount approval until Kimberly confirms commercial.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_PO_field_mapping.xlsx (XLSX, 14KB)

From: Aaron Lee <procurement@pioneerthera.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Sutherland <amy.sutherland@pioneerthera.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO field requirements and billing cadence for Redwood services

Ben / Kimberly — thanks for the fast turnaround and the mapping doc. After internal review:

- We can send a signed PO that includes the deal id (P-THERA-202704), cost center, and GL code.
- Pioneer will accept a monthly consolidated invoice (invoice issued on the 5th of the following month) with net45 payment terms.
- Pioneer would like the option to move to net30 with the 1.5% discount after a successful pilot (we'll confirm during the renewal conversation).

We'll circulate the signed PO to you by EOD Friday 2027-04-09. For the pilot, please proceed with monthly billing on the 5th and include the required PO fields. Appreciate the flexibility on EDI/reporting.

Aaron Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
Pioneer Therapeutics
Attachment: Signed_PO_Pioneer_0427.pdf (PDF, 9KB)
